The main takeaway from our work is that
NORM concentrations are highly variable in U.S. coal and CCRs, and this variability must be considered in any environmental risk assessments or remediation efforts related to these materials.
NORM in CCRs is a function of coal type, and the potential for human exposure to NORM from CCRs is dependent on the coal source basin.
